source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
win64-ccov/opt:
    description: "Win64 Opt Code Coverage"
    index:
        product: thunderbird
        job-name: win64-ccov-opt
    attributes:
        enable-build-signing: true
    treeherder:
        platform: windows2012-64/ccov
        symbol: B
        tier: 2
    worker-type: b-win2022
    worker:
        artifacts:
            - name: public/code-coverage-grcov.zip
              path: workspace\obj-build\code-coverage-grcov.zip
              type: file
        max-run-time: 9000
        env:
            RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP: '1'
            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
            RUST_MIN_STACK: "16777216"
    mozconfig:
        variant: code-coverage
    run:
        using: mozharness
        comm-checkout: true
        clone-with: hg
        actions: [build]
        config-paths:
            - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
        options: [append-env-variables-from-configs]
        script: mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py
        config:
            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
            - builds/taskcluster_base_windows.py
            - builds/taskcluster_base_win64.py
            - builds/taskcluster_sub_win64/ccov_opt.py
    run-on-projects: ['comm-central']
    use-sccache: false
    optimization:
        never: null
    fetches:
        toolchain:
            - sysroot-wasm32-wasi
            - terser
            - win64-7zz
            - win64-cbindgen
            - win64-clang
            - win64-dump_syms
            - win64-grcov
            - win64-libotr
            - win64-mozmake
            - win64-nasm
            - win64-node
            - win64-rust-dev
            - win64-rust-size
            - win64-sccache
            - win64-winchecksec
            - winappsdk-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
